unit: $/m2 of building floor area, Christchurch, GST-exclusive, construction only

band.unit: $/m2 of building floor area, Christchurch, GST-exclusive, construction only
band.basis: Additive: QV CHC 1.0 m undercut-and-replace build-up 218.80 (rows t12:r3, t12:r4, t12:r5) + extension to the full QV/MBIE TC3 Type 1 extent 0 to 51.20 (t13:r8 less 218.80) + imported GAP40 fill upgrade 0 to 150.00 (t13:r14 less t13:r8) + minor sundries allowance 15 to 45. Low end 233.80 = minimum footprint-only 1.0 m replacement plus sundries; high end 465.00 = the full QV TC3 Type 1 imported-GAP40 build-up (420/m2) plus sundries. Centre 340 (not the arithmetic midpoint of 349.40) assumes the replacement method to roughly the Type 1 extent with part-imported fill. Method and treatment depth are geotechnical outcomes and QV publishes no stone column / CMC / jet grout / deep soil mixing rate, so the band is wide and confidence is low; cross-checked against EQC/Tonkin & Taylor's 2015 Christchurch trial rates per m2 of treated footprint ($176 to $225 gravel raft; $145 to $195 4 m stone columns), which escalated sit inside this band. Excludes building foundations and structural work, geotechnical investigation and design, and repairs to existing damage.

Construction-only ground improvement for a single-storey light commercial building on liquefaction-prone Christchurch ground, per m2 of building floor area, NZD, GST exclusive. LOW = QV excavate-and-replace build-up for 1.0 m depth (CHC 80 + 126 + 12.8 = 218.8/m2, rows t12:r3-r5) + 10/m2 allowance = 229. HIGH = QV TC3 'Type 1' deep replacement build-up total (CHC 420/m2, row t13:r14, ~3.1 m3/m2 replaced, ~2.3 m deep) + 25/m2 allowance = 445. The band spans METHOD AND DEPTH, so the method components are alternatives and are deliberately not summed; the band is not the arithmetic total of the rows listed. Independently corroborated by the 2015 EQC/Tonkin + Taylor Pilot tendered rates, which convert to ~246-322/m2 (rafts) and ~268-361/m2 (4 m stone columns) of building floor area. Excluded by the pinned scope and not priced: building foundations and structural work, geotechnical investigation and design, verification testing and construction monitoring, and repairs to existing damage. A band set by method/depth uncertainty, and by 2015-vintage column/raft pricing, so confidence is low rather than medium.

band.unit: $/m2 of building floor area (Christchurch, NZD, GST exclusive, construction cost only)
band.basis: Band envelope of two sourced alternatives, not a sum of both. LOW $250/m2 = sum of the QV CostBuilder Christchurch rows for a ~1 m deep reinforced replacement crust plus a minor dewatering/platform allowance ($80 + $126 + $36.2 + $10-40), which is the cheapest MBIE-style solution; the EQC 2015 published low ($36,000/146 m2 = $247/m2) cross-checks this closely, so current-day shallow-crust work is anchored around $250/m2. HIGH $500/m2 = the top of the EQC/Tonkin & Taylor published range for the four MBIE-endorsed cleared-site methods ($73,000/146 m2, excl GST, construction only, 2015 rates, unescalated), i.e. a deep-inclusion scheme such as 4 m stone columns or driven timber poles; treat this as conservative in 2026 dollars. CENTRE $375/m2 reflects a mid-range scheme (partial-depth replacement plus inclusions/stone columns) at roughly a 270 m2 treated area for a 146 m2 footprint. Confidence is LOW because: the method and treatment depth are not decided and move the answer by about 2x; the upper half rests on 2015 construction-only rates rather than a current contractor price; QV rows used are unreviewed and come from residential foundation tables; and the upper end of the band is not escalated to 2026. Excludes geotechnical investigation, design, consenting, construction monitoring and verification testing per the pinned scope.
